name: first-passage
install:
python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade pip
python3 -m pip install --user --require-hashes -r requirements-ops.lock
test -x /usr/local/bin/python || sudo ln -sf /usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/python
grep -q '.local/bin' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
grep -q '.local/bin' "$HOME/.profile" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.profile"
bash scripts/install_hooks.sh
